cell.intro: WASD/arrows: swim. Collect parts. E: level stats. Divide for perks.
cell.evolved: You evolved! Form {form}: room for {slots} parts
cell.evolved_last: Final form! Your lineage is ready to leave the pond
part.mouth_hint: Algae is worth double and floats to you.
diet.herbivore_desc: Eats algae only. Plant points buy defense and mobility.
diet.carnivore_desc: Eats meat only. Meat points buy attack and speed.
diet.omnivore_desc: Eats both, each worth half. Buys a bit of everything.
diet.title_start: Choose your diet  (arrows + Enter, or click)
diet.title_evolve: Evolved to form {form}! Keep or change your diet
up.title: Upgrades  (arrows + Enter, or click)
up.need_either: Need more points (plant and meat both count)
cell.part_shed: {part} came off: a {diet} has no use for it
aq.intro: A/D or left/right to turn, W or up to swim, S or down to slow. E: look down the lens.
aq.died: Bitten three times. You carry on as a relative.
aq.reveal_continue: Enter or E to dive in
aq.lens_title: The lens: you are the Gardener
aq.lens_controls: Left/right: change the water   Enter: let a generation pass   U: back into your creature
aq.lens_kin: Body thickness of your kin (slender to thick)
aq.evolved: You grew into form {n}: bigger, tougher, room for {slots} parts
aq.dup_part: You already have {part}: it became food
aq.died_v2: You died. A relative carries on: half your food progress lost{part}.
aq.division_controls: Left / right + Enter, or click. Sisters stay and compete on this map.
aq.sister_hunts: A sister is closing in. Watch for the bite!
aq.division_inherits: Keeps your levels, parts, river parts and unspent points.
aq.intro_v2: W/S swim  A/D turn  R/F up/down  Shift cruise/full speed  Q dash  Space jump  E upgrades  U the lens  ` admin
aq.mouth_grow: Grow to form {n} to leap into the river
aq.mouth_open: River mouth {arrow} {d}: breach in its light
aq.evolved_mouth: You grew into form {n}! The river mouth is open: rise and breach in its light
aq.river_start: The river takes you! Steer through the gaps, over rocks, under logs (or jump them). Hold W at full speed to go faster
aq.arrive_lake: A deep lake: bigger, darker, and the predators here are tougher
aq.arrive_ocean: The coast: the ocean opens out, and its hunters are the deadliest yet
aq.sharker: Your lineage grows more shark-like: aggression is shaping its body
aq.tired: Too tired: dash and breach need 50 stamina
aq.slot_river: river slot (found in a river run)
cell.evolve_ready: Form 4: keep playing, or close upgrades and press Enter for aquatic.
aq.out_of_breath: Out of breath: full speed needs at least 10 stamina
aq.bloom_open: The kelp bloom bursts open: big plant pods!
aq.look_plain: Your lineage's body is plain again
aq.look_aggressive: Your lineage grows more shark-like: aggression is shaping its body
aq.look_cautious: Your lineage grows armoured: caution is shaping its body
aq.look_adaptable: Your lineage grows sleek and streamlined: adaptability is shaping its body
aq.shark_hunts: A SHARK IS HUNTING YOU: breach, or get far away
aq.shark_blood: THE SHARK SMELLS BLOOD: run and heal
aq.next_map: Move on: swim to the river mouth, breach in its light
aq.evolve_ready: Ready to leave the water. Enter: evolve into the creature stage

aq.evolved_last_away: Final form {n}! Reach the coast to leave the water
